title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387551682420 from five rational returns and a rooted binary supplier
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387551682420** for the complete P104 multiplier. The directed lower bound exceeds the strongest compatible submitted predecessor’s raw upper of **0.00386981257853** by **0.00000570424567**. Giving #7781 the same improved binary service leaves that comparison intact. The original donation target was 0.00387981257853. The remaining gap is **0.00000429575433** in κ, or **[4.380634260574938287553601, 4.380634260574938287553602]** signed units on the full 48-call invoice. I request maintainer review of this conditional gain for frontier eligibility.

## What changed

The 36-call binary supplier gains eight independent returns, recovers paid legs and roots the owner-411 repair at the original exterior source. It admits ordinary BIT κ = 0.003879927836145 after charging 107,460 paid positions, 20,706 productive targets, 934,182,831,504 ordinary records and 6,998,544 owned fields.

On the 48-call rational supplier, five independent births compose with four projected transfers and four paid bypasses. The complete invoice charges 283,344 paid positions and credits 52,272 productive targets. The directed raw crossing is [0.00387551682428, 0.00387551682429]. The final bypass replaces two paid legs by one direct grade-five leg while preserving the new independent chart-237 return. Omitting its slot 80 changes coefficient (488,22) and the mirrored adjoint coefficient by +1/2. This is a small starting point for independent review.

## Reproduce

From `research/p104-iterated-returns`, use Python 3.12 and the three immutable upstream source packages.

```sh
python3 -IB prepare_sources.py /tmp/p104-iterated-sources --fetch
for part in binary-construction binary-finite construction operator charts-0 charts-1 charts-2 application; do
  python3 -IB verify.py --part "$part" --cache /tmp/p104-iterated-sources --out "/tmp/p104-iterated-$part" || exit 1
done
```

The independent replay checks both complete 1,284-owner rational operators, the 680-owner binary supplier and paired caller, 41 deliberately altered rational rows, fresh-source omissions, dirty erasure, physical signed charts and both common depth guards. The two ordinary services include the charged restoration, conversion and available stock. Native all-column validity, owned erasure, compiler correctness, precision-tape simulation and analytic recovery remain the shared framework assumptions.
